criteria.name: Evidence-grounded fit
criteria.guide: Every capability claim is tied to concrete project evidence; no unsupported strengths are invented.

criteria.name: Role relevance
criteria.guide: The note focuses on the requirements that actually define this role rather than generic AI keywords.

criteria.name: Specificity
criteria.guide: Names concrete projects, technologies, outcomes or responsibilities instead of vague enthusiasm.

criteria.name: Brevity
criteria.guide: Readable quickly; no filler, repetition or inflated marketing language.

criteria.name: Honest positioning
criteria.guide: Does not imply seniority, credentials or experience not demonstrated by the supplied evidence.

anchors.high: Short note naming the role's core needs, two proven matching projects, one honest gap and a simple next step.
anchors.low: Generic AI enthusiasm, keyword stuffing, inflated seniority and claims with no project evidence.
